com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Assign one invoice to an active client in the same workspace. The invoice's saved financial values remain unchanged. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview assigning the invoice we selected to the active client we just found. Show both record IDs and the existing assignment, then wait for my confirmation.

annotations.title: Assign an invoice to a client

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_assign_invoice_client, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare moving an invoice's client assignment to an active client in the same workspace. Requires confirmation; saved financial data is not changed.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: assign_invoice_client
